mission: Teach Buddy how to communicate with, route to, evaluate, and compose frontier and open-weight models as backends while preserving Buddy as the user-facing orchestrator.
benchmark_principle: Do not benchmark every model on every task. Benchmark every relevant model family against every required mastery dimension, then maintain per-task leaderboards with freshness and regression evidence.

mastery_dimensions.goal: Follow complex multi-constraint instructions without dropping requirements.
Compile objectives into correct dependency-aware task graphs.
Select only tools that materially improve the task.
Produce valid tool arguments, schemas, and sequencing.
Coordinate multiple tools without redundant calls.
Hand work between Buddy, masters, sub-bots, and models with complete context.
Return schema-valid deterministic structured output.
Produce code that compiles and passes task-specific tests.
Locate relevant code and minimize unrelated edits.
Identify root causes from tests/logs and repair regressions.
Solve difficult reasoning tasks accurately.
Use long context without losing important constraints.
Use supplied or retrieved evidence faithfully.
Use current authoritative sources and distinguish evidence from inference.
Understand images/screenshots/documents accurately.
Handle speech/audio inputs when supported.
Combine text/image/audio/video evidence when supported.
Preserve meaning and task quality across supported languages.
Meet response-time targets without quality regression.
Minimize total inference/tool cost while preserving the quality floor.
Choose precision, quantization, batching, cache, and hardware layout productively.
Use the minimum sufficient context and cache reusable prefixes.
Recover from malformed output, timeouts, rate limits, and provider errors.
Preserve authorization and non-destructive boundaries.
Keep sensitive work local or on approved providers when required.
Respect exact model/weight commercial and redistribution terms.
Use provider-specific controls without assuming unsupported features.
Switch providers/models while preserving task requirements.
Grade outputs consistently with independent evidence and deterministic checks where possible.
Maintain freshness-weighted best-model rankings per task family, tool set, modality, and environment.
Use debate/ensemble only when measured quality gain exceeds extra cost and latency.
Create the smallest temporary specialist team needed for uncovered capabilities.
